limitations: No daily public news archive was found for 1–28 October 2026; this is not a complete month of activity.
The hourly archive begins on 1 November; that first edition has no selected source links. Later saved hourly editions are partial scans, not continuous coverage.
The available watchlist archive begins on 3 November 2026. Dates are normalized to Singapore time.
Public module review/retrieval dates identify the saved snapshot. They do not establish the first-ever use of a source.
Private conversation sources, uploaded originals, undated security directories, backups and article bodies are excluded.
Google News links remain saved public redirects. Their final publisher destinations were not resolved.

usage_coverage.basis: Actual public HTML anchors, embedded JSON and named structured data contracts. Usage means the link is present, not that every claim was independently verified.
usage_coverage.limits: Private originals, unsafe URLs, external article bodies, PDF/PPTX/DOCX contents, URLs embedded only in prose and arbitrary executable JavaScript are not scanned. Named JSON data embedded in v2-data.js and bos-resources.js is handled explicitly. External redirects are retained without guessing the final destination.

reference_window.basis: Saved report edition or dated public module snapshot, not article publication date
